asset.aiGeneratedDisclosure: This fictional shoreline plate was generated with OpenAI's built-in image generation tool and reviewed for this project.

generation.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: far-field environment plate for a real-time browser shoreline cinematic
Primary request: Create a convincingly photorealistic fictional temperate ocean coastline for a 16:9 cinematic background plate.
Scene/backdrop: expansive pale-blue sky with naturally varied soft cumulus clouds; crisp but atmospherically softened horizon; blue-green ocean with believable small wind waves, foam lines, and light variation; broad damp beige sand; several irregular weathered dark granite rock formations concentrated toward the left and right edges, leaving the center open.
Style/medium: high-end natural landscape photography, real optical depth and material texture, not a render or illustration.
Composition/framing: wide eye-level 35 mm lens view, level horizon at about 42 percent of image height, open central shoreline, usable continuous lower foreground that can be covered by a 3D contact stage, distant features remain plausible during a small camera push and lateral drift.
Lighting/mood: soft late-morning sunlight from upper left, coherent long soft-edged shadows, mild sea haze, restrained cinematic dynamic range, natural exposure and white balance.
Materials/textures: fine damp sand variation, wet reflective patches near the waterline, detailed mineral grain and erosion on rocks, translucent wave edges and white foam, realistic cloud volume.
Constraints: fictional non-distinctive location; no reference images; no people, faces, silhouettes, animals, boats, buildings, roads, signs, brands, logos, writing, watermark, or recognizable landmark; no dramatic fantasy formations; no duplicated rocks; no impossible reflections; no excessive HDR or teal-orange grading; no shallow depth of field; no motion blur; all of sky, sea, sand, and rocks must be clearly readable.
